visual_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 1, despite some overlapping/garbled transition text and cluttered axes, consistently shows the correct algebraic reduction and complex-plane directions, whereas Lesson 2 is visually cleaner but includes a substantive wrong title saying “Squaring (1 + 1)” instead of “(1 + i)” and offers fewer conceptually precise visual cues.

interactivity.rationale: Lesson 1 includes a well-formed, wired quiz gate with a real question, options, correct answer, and matching plan node after a specific act, while Lesson 2 has no available gate specs or plan and therefore no functioning interactivity.

narration_quality.rationale: Lesson 1 provides coherent, well-paced narration with only minor phrasing/notation issues like 'two-i,' whereas Lesson 2 has no available narration transcript at all and therefore cannot demonstrate clear or defect-free audio.

sync.rationale: Lesson 1 provides mostly relevant visual cues near the narration points that reference them despite a few imperfect offsets and a missing derivation cue, while Lesson 2 has no transcript or cue timing at all, making its sync effectively absent.

concept_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 1 is mathematically correct and pedagogically builds the shortcut through algebra, an intermediate check, and geometric intuition, while Lesson 2 has no available script or plan, so it provides no verifiable concept explanation at all.

polish.rationale: Lesson 2 is visually simple but consistently clean, centered, and free of overlaps, whereas Lesson 1 has a more modern style but suffers from cluttered split panels, empty boxes, mangled/overlapping formulas, axes cutting through elements, and clipped content near the top in later frames.

aggregator.explanation: Lesson 1 is the clear overall winner: five of six dimension agents favored it, most with very high confidence. It substantially outperforms Lesson 2 on interactivity, narration quality, synchronization, and concept accuracy because it has a functioning quiz, coherent narration, timed visual cues, and a verifiable mathematically correct explanation. It also wins visual accuracy despite some clutter because its visuals support the correct algebra and complex-plane interpretation, while Lesson 2 contains a substantive title error and lacks key instructional evidence. Lesson 2 only wins polish, with clean and uncluttered visuals, but that single advantage is outweighed by Lesson 1's much stronger instructional completeness and accuracy.
